summary:
Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive on Monday, less than two weeks after he resigned amid news of his affairs. Trump said he had convinced Nvidia to bring Huang back, and his return helped add $1tn to the company's stock value. Members of Congress from both parties criticised the decision, and German foreign minister Johann Wadephul said he was shocked by Trump's intervention.

Israeli air strikes in Gaza on Tuesday killed Brigadier General Naeem Abu Nahel, director-general of the Palestinian territory's Internal Security Service, along with six other people, including two police officers and a 17-year-old, the ministry said. Israel's military said it had struck a senior terrorist from Hamas, despite a ceasefire in place since last year.

Ousted prime minister Sheikh Hasina, who has spent two years in exile in India, has set 16 December as her return date to Bangladesh. She was sentenced to death in absentia last year, and the United Nations has said as many as 1,400 people were killed during the unrest that forced her out. In China, Shanghai party secretary Chen Jining was placed under investigation on suspicion of severe violations of party discipline and state laws.

headlines.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO under Trump pressure
headlines.summary: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive on Monday, less than two weeks after he resigned amid news of his affairs. Trump said he had convinced Nvidia to bring Huang back, and members of Congress from both parties criticised the decision.

headlines.title: Israeli strike kills Hamas internal security chief in Gaza
headlines.summary: Israeli air strikes in Gaza on Tuesday killed Brigadier General Naeem Abu Nahel, director-general of the Internal Security Service, and six other people, including two police officers and a 17-year-old. Israel's military said it had struck a senior terrorist from Hamas, despite a ceasefire in place since last year.

headlines.title: Sheikh Hasina says she will return to Bangladesh on 16 December
headlines.summary: Ousted prime minister Sheikh Hasina, in exile in India for two years, has set 16 December as her return date, the first time she has named a date. She was sentenced to death in absentia last year, and the United Nations has said as many as 1,400 people were killed during the unrest that forced her out.

headlines.title: China investigates Shanghai party secretary Chen Jining
headlines.summary: Chen Jining, party secretary of Shanghai, has been placed under investigation on suspicion of severe violations of party discipline and state laws. Before his downfall, the technocrat was seen as a future national leader in Xi Jinping's China.

headlines.title: Kyiv claims attacks on Russian vessels off Libya as self-defence
headlines.summary: Ukraine has claimed responsibility for attacking a Russian warship and a cargo vessel off Libya, and Kyiv says the action was self-defence. Days later, a Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia killed two people and destroyed a house, Ukrainian officials said.

headlines.title: Malaysia seeks another host for Rohingya after Turkey refuses transfer
headlines.summary: Turkey has rejected a proposed transfer of Malaysia's 133,000 Rohingya refugees, days after the UN's top court found Myanmar responsible for genocide against the minority. Prime Minister Anwar said Malaysia will continue looking for other countries, including OIC members, willing to take them.

headlines.title: UK heat deaths reach record 5,258 in summer 2026
headlines.summary: The UK Health Security Agency estimates that heat-related deaths for the summer of 2026 have reached 5,258. The agency's figure is a record for the UK.
